mechanism: Betamethasone may reduce the antihypertensive and cardioprotective effects of sacubitril through sodium/fluid retention and increased angiotensin II activity, while sacubitril may increase systemic corticosteroid exposure via neprilysin inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure, renal function, and volume status closely; may require sacubitril dose adjustment or alternative corticosteroid with lower systemic availability; avoid prolonged concurrent use when possible.
